name: How long does foggy window repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does foggy window repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for foggy window repair varies based on the method chosen and the number of windows. If only the insulated glass unit (IGU) is being replaced, the initial measurement and ordering of the new glass typically takes a few days to a few weeks, depending on custom specifications. The actual installation of the new IGU is usually a quick process, often completed within an hour or two per window by a skilled technician. For defogging services, the process can be quicker, usually completed in a single visit, but results may vary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foggy window repair time varies; replacing an insulated glass unit (IGU) involves ordering time (days to weeks) plus quick installation (1-2 hours per window), while defogging may be a single visit.
